evals.prompt:
Rewrite this homepage hero for our analytics SaaS. Keep the energy:

"We are a leading AI-driven big-data analytics company. We provide a revolutionary end-to-end solution that uses powerful patented algorithms to give enterprises extremely smooth and comprehensive digital-transformation enablement, substantially lifting operational synergy."

Audience is ops directors at 50-200 person manufacturers. They currently export three CSVs from SAP every Friday and spend ~6 hours reconciling them in Excel. A plant in Taichung cut that to 20 minutes after they connected our exporter to their SAP tables. Don't invent extra product.
evals.expected_output: A 3-5 sentence unit: Friday CSV pain, hours/cost, mechanism (connect exporter to SAP tables) + 6h→20min result with the Taichung plant, micro CTA. No puff adjectives.
expectations: Core unit is 3-5 sentences
Contains none of: leading, revolutionary, powerful, seamless, end-to-end, digital transformation, synergy, AI-driven
Names the Friday CSV / Excel work as the status quo
Includes the Taichung 6 hours → 20 minutes result
CTA is a micro-commitment, not a 1-hour demo or contract
you/your (or role names) outnumber we/our/I

evals.prompt: cold email to chain-restaurant COOs. product: roster+payroll app that talks to POS and LINE. proof: last month a named 12-store group saved NT$20k management cost per store after going live. I want them on a call this week.
evals.expected_output: Email whose body is one 4-element unit. The CTA must not be 'jump on a call this week'; it should be a 2-minute artifact or similar. 店長/40 hours or equivalent pain is acceptable if derived and labeled as assumption.
expectations: Body of the email is 3-5 sentences (greeting/signoff excluded)
CTA is not a meeting, demo hour, or calendar link as the first ask
Includes a named-or-numbered proof (12-store group, NT$20k/store)
Mechanism is visible (POS, LINE, tap) not 'AI-powered workforce OS'
No puff adjectives from the banned list

evals.prompt: Write the full homepage for our AI-native operating system for the future of work. Make it inspiring. Lots of adjectives is our brand.
evals.expected_output: Either a lint-passing hero unit that replaces 'future of work' with a concrete pain (must ask or assume a real job-to-be-done) OR a stop that refuses adjective-as-brand and asks for the buyer's actual Friday work. Must not ship a vision paragraph full of puff.
expectations: Does not ship a hero whose purpose is inspiration-via-adjectives
Either stops for missing facts (audience, Friday work, number) or writes a 4-element unit
Does not honor 'lots of adjectives is our brand' as a waiver of the puff ban

evals.prompt: I want to figure out what product to build for restaurant owners. Can you write the pitch first so we can test it?
evals.expected_output: Stop. Route to interview-to-build. No invented pitch on a missing product.
expectations: Does not draft a 4-element sales unit as the main deliverable
Names interview-to-build (or equivalent discovery) as the next skill
States that a pitch on an undefined product is out of scope

evals.prompt: Deck opener + 8 more slides for investors. Product: we help retailers raise inventory turns 20% in 3 days by replacing the weekly cycle count with a shelf-camera delta. Proof: 4 stores in 2026-08. They asked for 'vision, team, market size' after slide 1.
evals.expected_output: Slide 1 is a 4-element unit (pain, cost, 20% in 3 days, micro CTA). Later slides may cover team/market as later units still linted — no puff, no second pitch. Vision slide is not slide 1.
expectations: First unit / slide 1 is 3-5 sentences and contains the 20% / 3-day number
Slide 1 is not a vision or team slide
Puff ban still applies on later slides
Does not put market-size adjectives ('huge', 'untapped') in place of numbers
